Name: Even Better Artisan Good Icons for Cornucopia-MoreFlowers
Author: PlepArts
Description:
This Mod adds new icons for honey added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia-MoreFlowers[/url]

I use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22144]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url] Framework.

If you want the custom sprites you need to change the link in the "Data" JSON-file for example

  ﻿ "Honey": "assets/honey.png",
to
  ﻿ "Honey": "assets/honey_custom.png",



For Cornucopia-MoreCrops download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22377]EBAGI C-MC[/url]



Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/198773339]haze1nuts[/url] for making the Framwork Mod
